patterns: Do you sign an NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) before we discuss my idea?
Is my idea safe with you?
responses: Yes, absolutely. We prioritize your confidentiality and are fully prepared to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before you share any sensitive project details or ideas with us.

patterns: Who owns the source code / Intellectual Property after the project is completed?
Do I get the source code?
responses: Once the project is successfully completed and all payments are settled, you will have 100% ownership of the final source code and Intellectual Property (IP).

patterns: How do you ensure my website is secure from hackers?
responses: We follow industry-standard security practices, including SSL encryption, secure coding guidelines (OWASP), regular vulnerability patching, and database encryption to ensure your application remains protected against threats.
